paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-QwQ-32B
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity of different quantization schemes—4-Fbit (blue bars) and 2-Fbit (green bars)—across 64 blocks, indexed from 0 to 63, in the context of the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-QwQ-32B model. The horizontal axis, labeled "Block Index," is linearly scaled and marked at intervals of 15 (0, 15, 31, 47, 63), indicating the position of each block in the model. The vertical axis, labeled "Sensitivity," uses a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻⁴, with tick marks at regular logarithmic intervals. For each block index, two adjacent bars represent the sensitivity values for the 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit quantization methods, respectively. The green bars (2-Fbit) are consistently shorter than the blue bars (4-Fbit) across most block indices, indicating lower sensitivity for the 2-Fbit scheme. Notably, the sensitivity values for both schemes are relatively low and stable across the first 30 blocks, with a gradual increase observed from block 31 onward. The 4-Fbit sensitivity values rise more sharply, particularly from block 47 to 63, where the blue bars reach the upper end of the scale (near 10⁻⁴), while the green bars remain below 10⁻⁵. The bars are arranged in groups of two per block index, with no explicit sorting or emphasis on any particular block, and the legend in the top-left corner clearly distinguishes the two quantization methods by color.
